mission: Modularize the ~92k-LOC repo CLI: split the 27 files >=1000 LOC along natural seams into canonical role files, extract a shared internal substrate (subprocess, git, JSON/JSONC, ratchet, gh, schema kits), bring touched command groups to full topology compliance, and raise JSDoc on touched files to the .patterns rubric.

lockedDecisions.placement: internal-first; adopt existing owners; no new packages
lockedDecisions.scope: all files >=1000 LOC plus full topology for touched groups
lockedDecisions.behavior: behavior-preserving; consolidate via parameterization; unification proposed explicitly, never silent
lockedDecisions.jsdoc: touched files to .patterns/jsdoc-documentation.md rubric per wave; docgen:local proof
lockedDecisions.delivery: single branch repo-cli-modularization, wave commits, local yeet verify, one PR at end
lockedDecisions.schemaIdentity: re-derive $I from new module path; regen schema catalog per wave (bun run beep lint schema-catalog --write)
lockedDecisions.tests: migrate to @beep/repo-cli/test/<Group> aliases against facades/test-kits; null deep specifiers once migrated; gate on no NEW failures
lockedDecisions.agents: repo-general specialists in .claude/agents mirrored via .agents symlink

discovery.method: 41-agent workflow: 27 per-file seam analyses, 7 reuse sweeps, topology audits, infra + test maps, synthesis
knownGaps: reuse sweeps cli-plumbing and proc-git failed on transport errors (covered by per-file analyses)
audit chunk CreatePackage/Docgen/Docs/Fallow/Files/Graphiti failed (Files/Docgen/Graphiti covered by per-file analyses)

phases.name: Packet, agents, clean tree
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: Dirty edits landed, packet + agents committed, changeset present, test baseline recorded (fully green: 39 files / 547 tests).

phases.name: In-package shared substrate
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: internal/process, internal/repo-run/GitExec, internal/cli extensions landed additively with unit tests, rubric JSDoc, and pilot adoptions.

phases.name: Cross-package seeds and contracts
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: repo-utils/ai-metrics extensions, ratchet engine, wire contract, gh plumbing, JSONC/env kits landed; emitted formats unchanged.

phases.name: Pilot groups Files + Docgen
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: Both groups fully role-compliant, tests migrated to facades/test-kits, playbook proven.

phases.name: Quality family
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: Tasks/Quality.command/FallowQuality re-seamed; QualityTaskStep consumers on internal/process; ratchets on the shared engine.

phases.name: Lint + Laws
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: ts-morph kit extracted; SchemaFirst and DualArity split; wire contract emitter stable.

phases.name: Yeet
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: Handler/Closeout/QualityIssueIndex split onto shared substrate with publish invariants proven by existing tests.

phases.name: Metrics/data family
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: AIMetrics/AgentEffectiveness/Corpus decomposed onto shared DuckDb/exec/wire modules.

phases.name: Long tail + closing sweep
phases.exitCriteriaSummary: Remaining groups compliant; schema-primitives sweep done; PR published and mergeable; reflection recorded.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until the campaign branch ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --message -> monitor).
